# Default PR template

The following templates are available to guide you on how to describe a new contribution to this repo:
- bugfix.md
- feature.md
- refactor.md

To use them, add the *query param* **template** to your PR draft's URL with the name of the template you want to use. For instance, if you PR draft's URL looks like:

`https://github.com/sortile/{repoName}/compare/{destinationBranch}...{originBranch}`

and you're working on a refactor, the new URL should be:

`https://github.com/sortile/{repoName}/compare/{destinationBranch}...{originBranch}?template=refactor.md`

By doing this, you'll see the `refactor.md` template in action along with further instructions
